title: Ruinous Manipulations
subtitle: Mortem — blood remembers death
text: Ruinous blood has witnessed too much dying. Vital Reservoir (QUICK, 50): siphon death-adjacent energy from nearby decay and store it as a temporary buffer in the blood. Hemorrhage (QUICK, ?): tear open a target's vessels, inflicting deep blood-loss over several seconds. Exsanguinate (QUICK, ?): forcibly draw blood from a target outward — the most violent of the common manipulations. Crimson Tithe (QUICK, high cost): offer your own blood to the Qliphoth in exchange for a significant power surge. A Saint's gift, not a student's tool.
